# Enhanced Delete Tests — verify delete with index and log integration

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Delete Test Note
summary: Note for delete testing
tags: test
---
Note content for delete test.
-- note-input.md --

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Unindexed Note
summary: Note not in index
tags: test
---
Unindexed note content.
-- note2-input.md --

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write a note ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

exec akb write delete-note.md <../note-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/delete-note.md'

# --- Add note to index ---

exec akb index add kb/notes/delete-note.md "Delete test summary"
stdout 'Added kb/notes/delete-note.md to index'

# Verify entry is in index
exec akb index show
stdout 'delete-note.md'

# --- Delete the note ---

exec akb delete notes/delete-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/delete-note.md'

# --- Verify file is removed ---

! exists kb/notes/delete-note.md

# --- Verify index entry is removed ---

exec akb index show
! stdout 'delete-note.md'

# --- Verify log contains deletion entry ---

exec akb log show --type delete
stdout 'delete'
stdout 'delete-note.md'

# --- Delete a page not in index succeeds without error ---

exec akb write unindexed-note.md <../note2-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/unindexed-note.md'

exec akb delete notes/unindexed-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/unindexed-note.md'

! exists kb/notes/unindexed-note.md

# --- Cannot delete index.md ---

! exec akb delete kb/index.md
stderr 'cannot delete index.md'

# --- Cannot delete log.md ---

! exec akb delete kb/log.md
stderr 'cannot delete log.md'

# --- Cannot delete index.md with just filename ---

! exec akb delete index.md
stderr 'cannot delete index.md'

# --- Cannot delete log.md with just filename ---

! exec akb delete log.md
stderr 'cannot delete log.md'
